generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Contractors should have civil contractor registration in BWSSB or KPWD/KUWSDB, etc

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Form of tender is mandatory to upload in KPPP portal.
Assessed available tender capacity is AxNx2.5-B should be greater than 75.00 Lakhs (Inclusive of GST)
Amount put to tender is exclusive of GST & Rates quoted shall be exclusive of GST

The Tenderer Should have a in the last 5 years period achieved in at least two financial years an average turnover of not less than estimated cost of the respective works (Profit & loss account, Balance sheet certified/Audited by chartered accountant).i.e.,Rs.75.00 Lakhs (Inclusive of GST)
The Tenderer should have satisfactorily completed one similar work such as providing and laying of UGD pipeline to an extent of 50% of the cost of the respective works. i.e.,Rs.37.50 Lakhs.
Liquid assets and or availability of credit facilities usually 30percentage of the amount of contract i.e., Rs.22.50 Lakhs. (Inclusive of GST)

The tender should have executed in any one year the following minimum quantities of works usually 80percentage of the annual requirement of providing and laying 300mm dia and above RCC NP3 pipe is 352 rmt and 230mm dia and above GSW pipe is540 Rmt
